# Requirements

Codify's graph has never resolved a call. refs.sym_id is the enclosing caller, not the target; the callee is matched at query time by string equality on the name, and resolve_best picks a winner from the same-named candidates even when nothing distinguishes them. Resolve references at index time instead — against imports, visibility, and the declared dependency manifests — and store the verdict beside the edge. Two things fall out of one column. Impact and context traverse the edge that exists rather than every symbol sharing a name, and every name the repository cannot account for becomes visible. An agent that calls an API it invented, imports a package that is in no manifest, or lands one token off a real symbol writes a name nothing accounts for. That is the signal. The engineering is entirely in refusing to raise it anywhere else.

## Requirement 1: Definition sites

**User Story:** As the graph, I want only real definitions recorded so that resolution does not amplify a parse error into a wrong edge and a wrong finding.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a line uses a type rather than defining it THE indexer SHALL NOT record a definition.
2. WHEN a C or C++ aggregate is defined THE definition SHALL be recorded once, at the line carrying its body or its typedef name.
3. WHEN a translation unit includes a system header THE include SHALL be recorded as an import carrying the header name, so that the names the header provides can be accounted for.
4. WHEN a prototype and its definition both appear THE symbol SHALL be recorded once, so that the resolver is not offered a choice that has no meaning.
5. WHEN the precision changes land THE recorded symbol count SHALL fall toward the hand-counted truth for the fixture tree and no reference resolvable before SHALL become unresolvable.

## Requirement 2: Resolution at index time

**User Story:** As an agent, I want impact and context to follow the edge that exists rather than every symbol sharing a name so that retrieval stops widening on common identifiers.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a file is indexed THE indexer SHALL resolve each call reference to at most one target symbol and SHALL store that target beside the reference.
2. WHEN several definitions share a name THE resolver SHALL decide by visibility and import evidence — same file, then a name this file explicitly imports, then the same package or directory, then a unique definition repository-wide — and SHALL record which rule decided.
3. WHEN no rule decides between candidates THE reference SHALL be left unresolved rather than assigned a guess.
4. WHEN callers, callees, impact, and test-impact run THE traversal SHALL follow stored targets and SHALL NOT fall back to name equality for a reference that resolved.
5. WHEN impact runs on a name carrying several definitions THE result SHALL contain only the callers of the definition asked for.
6. WHEN resolution runs over this repository THE full index time SHALL stay within 10 percent of the pre-resolution baseline and SHALL add no link-time dependency.

## Requirement 3: Accounting for the outside

**User Story:** As a maintainer, I want every name the repository legitimately uses accounted for so that whatever remains is worth reading.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a name is a builtin of its language THE reference SHALL be recorded external and SHALL never become a finding.
2. WHEN an import names a module declared in a dependency manifest THE import SHALL be recorded external and the names it brings into the file SHALL be accounted for.
3. WHEN an import names a path inside the repository THE import SHALL resolve to that file.
4. WHEN a member call's receiver has no known origin THE reference SHALL be recorded external and never unknown, because an unprovable name is not evidence.
5. WHEN a repository declares no manifest for a language THE references in that language SHALL be accounted external rather than reported.

## Requirement 4: Grounding

**User Story:** As a reviewer of agent work, I want names nothing accounts for surfaced so that an invented API is caught before it is committed.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a call resolves to no internal symbol and nothing external accounts for it THE reference SHALL be reported as ungrounded.
2. WHEN an import names a module that is neither a repository path nor declared in any manifest THE import SHALL be reported, and this SHALL be the highest-confidence finding the tool raises.
3. WHEN an ungrounded name is within typo distance of an existing symbol THE finding SHALL name that symbol as the likely intent.
4. WHEN a file's share of accounted references falls materially below the median for its language THE file SHALL raise no grounding finding and SHALL say why, because the parser is failing rather than the code.
5. WHEN a language is outside the resolving set THE references in it SHALL carry verdicts and SHALL raise no findings.

## Requirement 5: Contract

**User Story:** As an agent, I want calls checked against the shape of what they call so that a right name with the wrong arguments does not read as correct.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a call resolves to an internal definition and passes more arguments than that definition can accept THE call SHALL be reported.
2. WHEN a definition takes variadic, defaulted, or optional parameters THE arity check SHALL widen to the widest form it accepts and SHALL NOT report.
3. WHEN a call resolves to a symbol that is not callable THE call SHALL be reported as a kind mismatch.
4. WHEN a route declares a handler that resolves to no symbol THE route SHALL be reported.
5. WHEN the argument text at a call site cannot be counted with confidence THE call SHALL raise nothing.

## Requirement 6: Hygiene

**User Story:** As a reviewer, I want the code a change stranded so that unused work is caught where it is written rather than accumulating as a backlog.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN work is uncommitted THE hygiene findings SHALL cover only what that work introduced, measured against the last snapshot.
2. WHEN a symbol is an entry point, an export, a route handler, a test, or named by a dispatch table THE symbol SHALL NOT be reported as unused.
3. WHEN an imported name is referenced nowhere in its file THE import SHALL be reported.
4. WHEN a full-repository sweep is asked for explicitly THE same findings SHALL be produced over the whole tree, ranked, with an explicit count of whatever the cap elided.
5. WHEN a symbol is reachable only through dynamic dispatch THE limit SHALL be documented rather than worked around.

## Requirement 7: Surface

**User Story:** As an agent, I want the check where I already work so that grounding is part of the loop rather than a command to remember.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN cg guard runs over uncommitted work THE grounding, contract, and hygiene findings for those paths SHALL be reported.
2. WHEN a finding is reported THE default SHALL be a warning and blocking SHALL be opt-in, per the warn-dont-block rule.
3. WHEN cg check runs THE finding counts SHALL appear in its summary.
4. WHEN a file is open in an editor THE language server SHALL publish grounding and contract findings as diagnostics at the offending line.
5. WHEN an agent works over MCP THE same findings SHALL be available as a tool so that it can check its own work before committing.
6. WHEN cg review runs THE findings the change introduced SHALL be part of its report.
